summary: Iteration 106 e2e verification: password complexity policy across all password-setting endpoints, SuperAdmin provisioning with credits+email+CC, forgot/reset backend, dynamic M365 folders endpoint, mobile forgot-password/reset-password screens, and mobile You tab brand intro card. 33/33 backend pytest passed. Mobile UI critical flows verified end-to-end. Web /reset-password + SuperAdmin Users web fields verified by code + partial UI screenshot.

react_native_issues.issue: React-native-web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic warning only, not blocking. Reference: mobile console.

action_items: (Optional) Silence the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN-Web warning by moving pointerEvents into style (e.g. login.tsx bottomFade LinearGradient).
critical_code_review_comments: auth_utils.password_complexity_error is well-scoped and reused everywhere a password is set (signup, superadmin create/reset, self change, forgot/reset) — good DRY.

SuperAdmin _send_credentials_email inlines a template + reset-token issuance. Consider extracting into services/password_reset_email.py alongside the existing user-facing reset email for consistency and easier tweaking.

connectors.list_connector_folders returns fallback default folders when Graph/Gmail API errors — this masks provider misconfig from the UI. Consider surfacing a 'source: fallback' flag so the frontend can hint 'showing common folders — reconnect for full list'.
Reset-password mobile screen's complexity check is client-side; backend re-validates — good defense in depth.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (mobile forgot/reset, You tab brand card, web reset-password policy hint)

test_credentials: amit@demo.team / Demo@2026 (super admin, demo). sam@funasia.net / Perfect$2008 login was skipped in some cases — fell back to demo super admin. os@radciti.com / Summer$123 not exercised (per note: do not modify).
seed_data_creation: Provisioning test created + deleted a TEST_provision_* user with 500 credits via /superadmin/users (cleanup via /superadmin/users/{uid} DELETE inside the test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified: /auth/signup (invite-gated, 403 or 400 on weak pw), /auth/reset-password (400 on weak pw before token check), /superadmin/users (weak pw rejected; happy path returns credits_added + credentials_emailed and ws.credits_remaining >= 500), /superadmin/users/{uid}/reset-password (weak pw rejected), /me/password (weak rejected, strong accepted, verified round-trip demo pw restore), /auth/forgot-password (generic 200 for known+unknown), /connectors/m365/folders (200 with real folders list for connected m365 acct, 400 unsupported provider, 404 unknown account). Mobile UI: /(auth)/forgot-password and /(auth)/reset-password screens render and post to backend correctly; client-side policy blocks weak submits with clear per-rule message. You tab shows 'Enterprise AI Intelligence' brand intro card + 'New in TeamNest' cards. Web /reset-password page shows policy hint and Update-password button disabled until both password fields match and policy is met (verified via disabled state). SuperAdmin Users web tab (UsersTab.jsx) has data-testids: sa-add-credits, sa-add-sendemail, sa-add-cc plus the policy hint text — for direct Playwright verification, log in as amit@demo.team via /login form (not the landing 'Request Invite' page) then navigate to /superadmin -> Users tab.
